ownershipCases.name: elects exactly one owner during concurrent acquisition
uses distinct acquisition tokens and monotonically increasing epochs
expires at the exact local TTL and admits no further writes
renews on the request-start clock and exposes the next renewal time
demotes immediately when renewal loses its token
does not extend a lease from a delayed response arrival
fails closed on a renewal transport failure
releases its lease when the durable epoch CAS loses a race
never serves if the durable claim outlasts the lease
confirms the lease token again after the durable claim
fences the previous owner after simulated lease-store key loss
blocks an old transaction that arrives after another owner fences it
never retries or returns success when a committed write loses its response
returns version conflicts without retrying a proposal against different state
serializes writes and captures proposals before queueing
explicit release cancels an acquisition waiting on I/O
explicit release suppresses a late success response and queued writes
cannot be revived by malformed store responses or a backwards local clock
fails closed when the store reports an invalid commit version
keeps an accepted bid and absolute deadline through owner loss and settles once

limits: Atomic in-memory lease/fence models only. Not wired to the application; no cloud adapter, real datastore integration, independent review or staging reliability/capacity claim.
